definitions.u: Task Adam direction over parameters eligible for both task and pressure; no group LR or weight decay.
definitions.w: Unweighted pressure gradient preconditioned with the same task second moment; before projection.
definitions.rho_task_percent: 100*max(0,-dot(u,w))/(||u||^2+eps): removed component norm relative to task direction (manuscript definition).
definitions.removed_pressure_percent: 100*||w-w_safe||/||w||: norm of removed component relative to pressure, not energy or coordinate count.
definitions.pre_cap_ratio: lambda*||w_safe||/(||u||+eps)/b, after projection and before norm cap (manuscript r/b).
definitions.cap_active: Count(trust_scale<1)/712, including the zero-LR first boundary.

limits: Global pooled geometry cannot isolate the head contribution. Ph uses 6 tensors, Ph+head 7; weighting and eligible parameter pool both change. One seed.
